- Be concise. Use English.

  11  
  12  /**
  13   * @dev Implementation of a vault to deposit funds for yield optimizing.
  14   * This is the contract that receives funds and that users interface with.
  15   * The yield optimizing strategy itself is implemented in a separate 'Strategy.sol' contract.
  16   */
  17  contract BeefyVaultV7 is ERC20Upgradeable, OwnableUpgradeable, ReentrancyGuardUpgradeable {
  18      using SafeERC20Upgradeable for IERC20Upgradeable;
  19  
  20      struct StratCandidate {
  21          address implementation;
  22          uint proposedTime;
  23      }
  24  
  25      // The last proposed strategy to switch to.
  26      StratCandidate public stratCandidate;
  27      // The strategy currently in use by the vault.
  28      IStrategyV7 public strategy;
  29      // The minimum time it has to pass before a strat candidate can be approved.
  30      uint256 public approvalDelay;
  31  
  32      event NewStratCandidate(address implementation);
  33      event UpgradeStrat(address implementation);
  34  
  35      /**
  36       * @dev Sets the value of {token} to the token that the vault will
  37       * hold as underlying value. It initializes the vault's own 'moo' token.
  38       * This token is minted when someone does a deposit. It is burned in order
  39       * to withdraw the corresponding portion of the underlying assets.
  40       * @param _strategy the address of the strategy.
  41       * @param _name the name of the vault token.
  42       * @param _symbol the symbol of the vault token.
  43       * @param _approvalDelay the delay before a new strat can be approved.
  44       */
  45       function initialize(
  46          IStrategyV7 _strategy,
  47          string memory _name,
  48          string memory _symbol,
  49          uint256 _approvalDelay
  50      ) public initializer {
  51          __ERC20_init(_name, _symbol);
  52          __Ownable_init();
  53          __ReentrancyGuard_init();
  54          strategy = _strategy;
  55          approvalDelay = _approvalDelay;
  56      }
  57  
  58      function want() public view returns (IERC20Upgradeable) {
  59          return IERC20Upgradeable(strategy.want());
  60      }
  61  
  62      /**
  63       * @dev It calculates the total underlying value of {token} held by the system.
  64       * It takes into account the vault contract balance, the strategy contract balance
  65       *  and the balance deployed in other contracts as part of the strategy.
  66       */
  67      function balance() public view returns (uint) {
  68          return want().balanceOf(address(this)) + IStrategyV7(strategy).balanceOf();
  69      }
  70  
  71      /**
  72       * @dev Custom logic in here for how much the vault allows to be borrowed.

  76       */

  78          return want().balanceOf(address(this));
  79      }

  85      function getPricePerFullShare() public view returns (uint256) {
  86          return totalSupply() == 0 ? 1e18 : balance() * 1e18 / totalSupply();
  87      }

  89      /**
  90       * @dev A helper function to call deposit() with all the sender's funds.
  91       */
  92      function depositAll() external {
  93          deposit(want().balanceOf(msg.sender));
  94      }
  95  
  96      /**
  97       * @dev The entrypoint of funds into the system. People deposit with this function
  98       * into the vault. The vault is then in charge of sending funds into the strategy.
  99       */
 100      function deposit(uint _amount) public nonReentrant {
 101          strategy.beforeDeposit();
 102  
 103          uint256 _pool = balance();
 104          want().safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), _amount);
 105          earn();
 106          uint256 _after = balance();
 107          _amount = _after - _pool; // Additional check for deflationary tokens
 108          uint256 shares = 0;
 109          if (totalSupply() == 0) {
 110              shares = _amount;
 111          } else {
 112              shares = (_amount * totalSupply()) / _pool;
 113          }
 114          _mint(msg.sender, shares);
 115      }
 116  
 117      /**
 118       * @dev Function to send funds into the strategy and put them to work. It's primarily called
 119       * by the vault's deposit() function.
 120       */
 121      function earn() public {
 122          uint _bal = available();
 123          want().safeTransfer(address(strategy), _bal);
 124          strategy.deposit();
 125      }
 126  
 127      /**
 128       * @dev A helper function to call withdraw() with all the sender's funds.
 129       */
 130      function withdrawAll() external {
 131          withdraw(balanceOf(msg.sender));
 132      }
 133  
 134      /**
 135       * @dev Function to exit the system. The vault will withdraw the required tokens
 136       * from the strategy and pay up the token holder. A proportional number of IOU
 137       * tokens are burned in the process.
 138       */
 139      function withdraw(uint256 _shares) public {
 140          uint256 r = (balance() * _shares) / totalSupply();
 141          _burn(msg.sender, _shares);
 142  
 143          uint b = want().balanceOf(address(this));
 144          if (b < r) {
 145              uint _withdraw = r - b;
 146              strategy.withdraw(_withdraw);
 147              uint _after = want().balanceOf(address(this));
 148              uint _diff = _after - b;
 149              if (_diff < _withdraw) {
 150                  r = b + _diff;
 151              }
 152          }
 153  
 154          want().safeTransfer(msg.sender, r);
 155      }
 156  
 157      /** 
 158       * @dev Sets the candidate for the new strat to use with this vault.
 159       * @param _implementation The address of the candidate strategy.  
 160       */
 161      function proposeStrat(address _implementation) public onlyOwner {
 162          require(address(this) == IStrategyV7(_implementation).vault(), "Proposal not valid for this Vault");
 163          require(want() == IStrategyV7(_implementation).want(), "Different want");
 164          stratCandidate = StratCandidate({
 165              implementation: _implementation,
 166              proposedTime: block.timestamp
 167           });
 168  
 169          emit NewStratCandidate(_implementation);
 170      }
 171  
 172      /** 
 173       * @dev It switches the active strat for the strat candidate. After upgrading, the 
 174       * candidate implementation is set to the 0x00 address, and proposedTime to a time 
 175       * happening in +100 years for safety. 
 176       */
 177  
 178      function upgradeStrat() public onlyOwner {
 179          require(stratCandidate.implementation != address(0), "There is no candidate");
 180          require(stratCandidate.proposedTime + approvalDelay < block.timestamp, "Delay has not passed");
 181  
 182          emit UpgradeStrat(stratCandidate.implementation);
 183  
 184          strategy.retireStrat();
 185          strategy = IStrategyV7(stratCandidate.implementation);
 186          stratCandidate.implementation = address(0);
 187          stratCandidate.proposedTime = 5000000000;
 188  
 189          earn();
 190      }
 191  
 192      /**
 193       * @dev Rescues random funds stuck that the strat can't handle.
 194       * @param _token address of the token to rescue.
 195       */
 196      function inCaseTokensGetStuck(address _token) external onlyOwner {
 197          require(_token != address(want()), "!token");
 198  
 199          uint256 amount = IERC20Upgradeable(_token).balanceOf(address(this));
 200          IERC20Upgradeable(_token).safeTransfer(msg.sender, amount);
 201      }
 202  }
